item.title: [Lanka Talks] When Passion Meets Performance: Team CDB dominates the 41st Mercantile Athletics Federation Meet
item.description: In a dominant show of talent, teamwork and discipline, Citizens Development Business Finance PLC delivered a commanding performance at the 41st Mercantile Athletic Federation (MAF) Meet held from the 21st to 23rd August at the Mahinda Rajapaksa International Stadium, Diyagama. CDB clinched the Men's and Women's Overall Championship titles and the Men's Overall Novices Championship, showcasing a clean sweep across categories that underscored the strength and depth of CDB's sporting talent.
